row.name: Chemical Reactants
row.description:
Volatile assortment of compounds used for various purposes. Normally dispensed into a Chemical Storage Vessel.

Kinetic Breach (Pierced/Slashed): The chemicals mix and vent into the atmosphere. Roll 1d:
1-2 (Toxic Cloud): Vents a 2-yard radius cloud of poisonous gas. Anyone inside must make an HT-2 roll per turn or take 1d toxic damage. Lingers for 1d minutes.
3-4 (Corrosive Spill): Creates a 1-yard radius puddle of acid. Stepping in it deals 1d corrosive damage to footwear/feet. Falling in it deals 2d corrosive damage to the body.
5-6 (Choking Smoke): A rapid exothermic reaction creates a 3-yard radius cloud of thick, opaque smoke. Vision is at -5, and anyone breathing it without a filter mask must make an HT roll or suffer the Coughing affliction (-3 to DX and IQ) while inside and for 1d minutes after leaving.
Ignition / Energy Breach (Shot by Blaster): The thermal energy causes a catastrophic chain reaction. Damage: The container violently explodes, dealing 3d crushing explosive (cr ex) and 1d corrosive (cor) damage in a 2-yard radius.
